specs.prompt: Edit this approved 8-pose robot walking sheet into a PRODUCTION READY game sprite atlas. Preserve the identical ivory brass robot, teal eyes, full jointed body and all eight walking poses in the same FOUR columns by TWO rows. Crucial edit: REMOVE EVERY PART of the white/gray backdrop and ground shadow. Pixels outside each robot must be truly alpha 0 with a clean cutout edge, not a painted white canvas or semi-transparent wash. Exactly 8 full-body isolated robots, no floor or cast shadow, no text. Equal cells, identical robot body proportions and apparent height, feet contact aligned on identical baseline per row, no pose may touch another cell. Walking must alternate LEFT and RIGHT legs and counter-swing arms, no duplicated half cycle. Restore clean metal silhouettes and retain fine watercolor texture within robot. Keep front/back legs identifiable by near/far shading.

REMOVE all light gray/white background wash, grain outside silhouette, ground marks, blobs and cast shadow: all outside each character must be actual transparent alpha0. No opaque white canvas, checkerboard depiction, haze or labels. Keep metal and painted detail INSIDE character, clean isolated cutouts with generous transparent gutters.
